<action type="say">
I can set that up. I’ll just need some details first:

1) Dates and times
- When do you want to fly:
  • Austin (AUS) → Las Vegas (LAS): date and preferred time of day?  
  • Las Vegas (LAS) → San Francisco (SFO): date and time?  
  • San Francisco (SFO) → Austin (AUS): date and time?
- Are your dates flexible by a day or two, or fixed?

2) Travelers and cabin
- How many travelers, and are any children/infants?
- Which cabin: economy, premium economy, business, or first?
- Any airline preferences (e.g., only major US carriers, avoid basic economy, etc.)?
- Max number of stops (OK with 1 stop, or prefer nonstop only)?

3) Budget and other preferences
- Approximate budget per person for the whole trip?
- Any must-haves (e.g., free carry-on/checked bag, specific time windows, need Wi‑Fi)?

4) Booking info (so I know what to collect later)
- Will all tickets be under one main traveler? If so, what’s their full name and date of birth?
- Do you already know which payment method you’ll use (credit/debit/PayPal)?

Once you share this, I’ll search flights for each leg and show you the best options so you can pick what to book.
</action>
